OPENAI_KEY_GUIDE.TITLE: How to create your OpenAI key
OPENAI_KEY_GUIDE.SUBTITLE: The key is yours and lives in your OpenAI account. It takes about 5 minutes, and you pay them for usage directly.

STEPS.ACCOUNT: Create an account at platform.openai.com. That is the developer platform, not the ChatGPT website.
STEPS.BILLING: Under Billing, add between US$ 5 and US$ 10 with an international card. Without credit the key exists but never answers.
STEPS.AUTO_RECHARGE: Leave auto recharge off. You spend only what you added and decide when to top up.
STEPS.CREATE_KEY: Create a new key and choose no expiration. A key with an end date stops working on its own, mid conversation.
STEPS.COPY_NOW: Copy the key the moment it appears. OpenAI never shows it again: close the window and you have to create another one.
STEPS.PASTE_HERE: Come back here, click Connect and paste the key into the API Key field.

WARNINGS.SUBSCRIPTION: A ChatGPT Plus subscription does not work here. They are separate charges: API credit is its own thing.
WARNINGS.CARD: Card declined? OpenAI only accepts cards enabled for international purchases. Ask your bank to turn that on.
